Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are comfortable with us
recording this call?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was driving through an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and I was turning left onto a side road. The light had
been green for my direction when I started the turn.
Q: What did you see as you began the turn?
A: I checked for oncoming traffic and saw a vehicle a fair distance off. I thought I had time, so I started moving. Then
another car came from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.
Q: Did you notice that vehicle before you started the turn?
A: Not really. I looked, but I didn't see it until it was almost on me. I'm not sure if it was speeding or if my view was
blocked by the vehicles stopped in the other lane.
Q: What happened to you physically after the impact?
A: My left hand hit the steering wheel and the door frame. I had a lot of pain in my wrist right away. I was taken to a
hospital by ambulance, and they confirmed I had a fractured wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I have a follow-up
appointment with a hand specialist.
Q: Were there any witnesses or police at the scene?
A: An officer came out and took a report. I think a man in a pickup stopped to check on us, but I didn't get his
information.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: I just want to say I didn't intentionally pull out in front of anyone. I believe I was driving carefully, and I'm trying to
get my hand back to normal so I can return to work.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
